newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, volume slight, seen ranging.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, volume slight, seen ranging.

text.p: April Brent crude futures in Asia were slightly firmer on Thursday in late trading in range trading with short term direction unclear, brokers said.
April Brent on SIMEX last traded at $19.65 per barrel, up seven cents from London, which closed in the middle of its intraday trading range at $19.58. About 69 lots were registered.
Brokers said they expected the market to range-trade between $19.10, this week's low so far, and $19.85, this week's high so far.
But they said background news would push prices to test higher levels rather than lower ones.

A potential strike on Friday by Nigerian oil workers, who process export documents, reports of imminent unrest in northern Iraq and a large gasoline draw in U.S. stocks, were providing underlying support to the market, they said.
NYMEX crude futures on ACCESS were also modestly firmer, with April last trading at $21.13, up two cents from New York.
March gasoline continued its march higher, gaining 0.19 cent per gallon on ACCESS to 62.45 after rising 0.03 on NYMEX.
